test_cases_present: partial - the spec provides functional descriptions and waveform figures that map to compliance test scenarios but does not provide a formal test plan or testbench.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior: SPE=0, SPTEF=1, MODF=0, SPIF=0 after reset.
Master mode transmission: write to SPIDR + half-SCK delay + 16 SCK edges + SPIF set.
Slave mode transmission: SS goes LOW + 16 SCK edges from master + SPIF set after 16th edge.
Mode fault: configure as master + SS pulled LOW + MODF set + MSTR cleared.
All four (CPOL, CPHA) clock format combinations.
Bidirectional mode: SPC0=1 + BIDIROE direction control.
Receive overrun: third byte received while SPIF still set (oldest byte in shift register).
Wait/Stop mode: SPISWAI behavior; slave-tracks-master while master halts.
